entities.summary: Teutonic Order, a political institution in Lithuania during Formation of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (1263–1385). Grew from Coronation of Mindaugas as King of Lithuania and Mindaugas & the Kingdom of Lithuania. Led to the emergence of Gediminas Dynasty & Grand Ducal Expansion and Gediminid.
